title: Miami Date Nights From Free to Fancy
igCaption:
Five Miami date nights, from free to fancy: sunset at South Pointe Park, a free movie at SoundScape Park, free night at PAMM (every 2nd Saturday), salsa at Ball & Chain, and cocktails 40 floors up at Sugar.

Who are you taking? Tag them 👀

Sources: Miami Tourism Guide, Pérez Art Museum Miami, The Rooftop Guide, EAST Miami

#miamidatenight #datenight #miami #southflorida

scenes.text: Five date nights in Miami, from free to fancy. And the first one costs nothing.
scenes.caption: Five date nights in Miami, from free to fancy. And the first one costs nothing.

scenes.text: Start free. Watch the sunset from South Pointe Park. It's the very bottom of Miami Beach, where the cruise ships sail out of PortMiami.
scenes.caption: Start free. Watch the sunset from South Pointe Park. It's the very bottom of Miami Beach, where the cruise ships sail out of PortMiami.

scenes.text: Still free. Bring a blanket to SoundScape Park. Movies play outdoors on the wall of the New World Center.
scenes.caption: Still free. Bring a blanket to SoundScape Park. Movies play outdoors on the wall of the New World Center.

scenes.text: The Pérez Art Museum is free every second Saturday of the month. The next one is October tenth. Otherwise it's sixteen dollars, right on Biscayne Bay.
scenes.caption: The Pérez Art Museum is free every second Saturday of the month. The next one is October 10. Otherwise it's $16, right on Biscayne Bay.

scenes.text: Want to dance? Ball and Chain on Calle Ocho has live music and free salsa lessons. Cocktails run about sixteen dollars.
scenes.caption: Want to dance? Ball & Chain on Calle Ocho has live music and free salsa lessons. Cocktails run about $16.

scenes.text: And to go big, head to Sugar. It's forty floors up, on top of the EAST hotel in Brickell. Go at golden hour on a weekday to skip the crowd.
scenes.caption: And to go big, head to Sugar. It's 40 floors up, on top of the EAST hotel in Brickell. Go at golden hour on a weekday to skip the crowd.
